## Context

gentar (aGENT ARena) is the constellation's compose-native test arena — successor line to
agent-gauntlet. It installs subjects onto disposable benches (sbx Linux / tart macOS),
drives real agents at a pty, and asserts verdicts from reality (exit code = verdict;
0 pass / 1 fail / 2 refusal), with every step an OTel span in ClickHouse. Build plan v1
is exhausted: PR gate (6 suites, self-hosted runner on VM 142), nightly + dispatch tiers,
keyword tags, and two subjects onboarded (kommander-playbook, memhouse) all live on main.
The loop should work toward the deliberately deferred line in README "Not built yet":

multi-bench parallel matrices.
